property_summary: After a successful initialize() call, the changeFee state variable should always equal the value passed as _changeFee; the mutant fails to set it when the call is not a re-initialization, leaving it as zero.

For any valid first-time initialization, the changeFee stored must match the _changeFee argument; the mutant leaves changeFee as zero when the call succeeds because it moves the assignment after initialized=true, so a subsequent re-initialization attempt that does not revert will update changeFee differently.
